proc_p: Under-stairs storage takes four to six weeks to make once you approve the design.
steps: We measure the stairs, including the angle and how deep the space goes at the back.
You see the pull-outs, drawers and cupboards in 3D, with a quote that lists each one.
Every drawer and door is made to your staircase in our workshop.
We fit it so the drawers run smoothly and the doors sit flush, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
